opinions.text: Petitioner's petition for panel rehearing, Docket Entry No. 36, is GRANTED . The opinion filed April 23, 2019, and reported at 921 F.3d 898, is hereby withdrawn. The court will file a new opinion in due course. Because the court's opinion is withdrawn, the petition for rehearing en banc is DENIED as moot. Once a new opinion is filed, further petitions for rehearing and rehearing en banc may be filed.
